audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[0..6] reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Gangplank/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank, which contradicts both the packet chart (Gangplank/Skill/Sett/Sett/Skill/Sett/Gangplank) and its own whys — whys[0] says level 1 is Gangplank's, whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] all say Sett wins levels 3-5 and the first-item stage. The full layer's phases repeat the same wrong shape.
audit.why: Sett must walk into 625-range Parrrley to farm with no ranged answer, so level 1 is Gangplank's; from level 3 Facebreaker plus stored Haymaker owns the trade until Gangplank's Sheen-plus-crit two-item window.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to Gangplank/Skill/Sett/Sett/Skill/Sett/Gangplank with ratings to match.

audit.why: Content spikes are accurate and complete: level 1 Parrrley poke, level 2-3 Facebreaker plus stored Haymaker, level 6 The Show Stopper, and Gangplank's 2-item keg burst. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer builds everything on 'track Haymaker' and 'engage on Haymaker's cooldown'. Haymaker is his damage payoff, not his engage — Facebreaker (E) is the 490-range pull that starts every combo, on 16/14.5/13/11.5/10. The full layer also never states the two facts that decide the matchup: Facebreaker only STUNS if enemies are on opposite sides of him (alone, you are only slowed), and The Show Stopper is a suppression that Remove Scurvy cannot break.
audit.why: Riot text, Facebreaker (E): 'Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.' Haymaker (W) is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 and deals true damage in the centre, physical on the sides. The Show Stopper (R) is 120/100/80 at 400 range. Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14.
audit.corrected: Advice re-keyed to Facebreaker's 16s cooldown and 490 range; Haymaker's centre-only true damage and the suppression limit on Remove Scurvy stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Facebreaker at 16s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown; Haymaker is 18s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[9].t.
